root_motivation: **Who:** the autonomous coding agent on a user's live key, asked to "delete the old rows" with a filter it wrote 30 s ago. **What:** a gate that costs one extra call when the blast radius is large and nothing when it is small, and whose error teaches the dry-run path. **Why not today:** dry_run exists but is optional; no tool descriptor carries destructiveHint, so clients show no warning for host.table.drop.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.state.delete_rows with an empty filter on a 5 000-row table, reads confirm_required.dry_run_first, runs the dry run, notices the empty filter and fixes it; a Claude Code user who sees a destructive marker on host.table.drop.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given this PRD has landed, When the operator runs the premise check recorded under "## Premise check (operator)" below, Then its result is written into this PRD and a failed premise parks the PRD (Live; evidence: operator premise check, see "## Premise check (operator)")
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: Live premise check over prod/orch truth-tier transcripts, recorded by the operator after land.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a 5 000-row table and `confirm_rows_min` 100, When `host.state.delete_rows {table, where: {}}` is called without `confirm`, Then `confirm_required` is returned with `dry_run_first.args.dry_run == true`, `would.rows[0].delete == 5000`, and the table still has 5 000 rows; Given a `where` matching 12 rows, Then the delete runs with no token.

Given the dry run returned `confirm: c_…`, When the real call is made with the same args and `confirm` within 10 min, Then the rows are deleted and `confirm_tokens.used_unix` is set; When the same token is sent again, Then `confirm_invalid {reason: "used"}` and nothing changes.

Given a token minted for `{table: "jobs", where: {status: "done"}}`, When the real call changes `where` to `{}`, Then `confirm_invalid {reason: "args_changed"}`; When 100 new rows are appended between dry run and real call, Then `confirm_invalid {reason: "state_changed"}` with a fresh `would`; When 601 s pass, Then `reason: "expired"`.

Given `tools/list` for a keyed tenant, When read, Then every registry verb of a gated kind carries `annotations.destructiveHint == true` and a description ending in the confirm sentence, every non-gated verb carries neither, and `docs/host-tools.md` contains the sentence once per gated verb.
Given a scratch tenant key, When `host.table.drop {name}` on a 5 000-row table is called without `confirm`, Then it succeeds and the response has `_meta.scratch == true` and no `confirm` field.

Given plan `free` with `confirm_rows_min: 100` and a plan override setting it to 0, When a 5 000-row delete is called on the overridden tenant, Then it runs without a token and `host.quickstart.limits.plan.confirm_rows_min == 0`.

Given landed prod and joe-test throwaway table `cnfm_live` (150 rows), When `host.state.delete_rows {table: "cnfm_live", where: {}}` is called, Then reply 1 is `confirm_required`, dry run returns a `confirm`, the confirmed call deletes 150 rows and `host.tool_logs` shows `minted` then `used` (Live; evidence: `curl -s https://mcphost.dev/status.json | jq .version` = landed tag plus the three MCP responses, key/token redacted)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: live prod delete of joe-test table cnfm_live after deploy.

scope: src/confirm.rs (new): the gated set derived from WRITE_VERBS, token mint/hash, canonical args hash, confirm_required/confirm_invalid errors.
src/handler.rs: dispatch gate (dry-run measure, token check, scratch bypass), destructiveHint annotations and description suffix in host_tools.
non_goals: Human approval; gating scratch tenants; gating host.key.rotate and host.self.offboard; changing what any verb does once confirmed.

additional.token_never_stored: only sha256(token) is stored; the token is shown once by the dry run.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent delete 5 000 rows by accident?
five_whys_trace.a: dry_run is optional and nobody is required to read it.
Prose at a boundary is skipped; a refusal carrying the exact dry-run call cannot be.

five_whys_trace.q: Why bind the token to args and diff?
five_whys_trace.a: A token for another filter or another state would authorise a different delete.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which diffs are gated?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: A dry-run diff with a measurable row count (rows[].delete, tables[].rows) at or above plan confirm_rows_min; verbs that report no count are not gated yet.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Token bound to key or session?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Tenant (key hash), per the PRD default.
